one_on_one.hint: Structure the body as: Overview; Updates (what each person reported); Feedback and Concerns; Decisions; Next Steps. Keep each person's updates under their name.

standup.label: Standup
standup.hint: Structure the body as: Overview (one line); one section per person with Done, Doing, Blocked; Next Steps. Skip people who did not speak.

interview.label: Interview
interview.hint: Structure the body as: Overview (role and candidate if stated); Background; Strengths; Concerns; Notable answers (question and answer in one line each); Next Steps. Do not make a hire recommendation unless one was stated.

sales_call.label: Sales call
sales_call.hint: Structure the body as: Overview; Customer needs and pain points; Objections; Budget, timeline and decision makers (only what was stated); Decisions; Next Steps.

lecture.label: Lecture
lecture.hint: Structure the body as: Overview (topic and speaker); Key concepts (term and one-line definition); Examples and evidence; Questions raised; Takeaways. Decisions and Next Steps only if the session had any.
